title: Replace the isolated HOME consumer accept barrier busy-spin with a bounded blocking wait
outcome: Replace the isolated HOME consumer accept barrier busy-spin with a bounded blocking wait
acceptance: The isolated-HOME consumer barrier in src/tests/home_fixture.rs no longer yields in a nonblocking accept loop: it waits in a blocking or parked wait bounded by phase_sync::DEADLOCK_GUARD and fails with its barrier message when the consumer never connects.
The home_fixture tests pass in a full five-stage gate on a master tree that contains the change.
